data.desc: McEwen combines growing gold and silver production with a major copper development project and a royalty portfolio across the Americas. McEwen shares trade on the NYSE and TSX under MUX. McEwen holds a 46.3% interest in McEwen Copper, owner of Los Azules, a large, long-life copper project in San Juan, Argentina. The shovel-ready project completed its Feasibility Study and received approval under Argentina's Large Investment Regime (RIGI) in 2025. McEwen also holds a 1.25% net smelter return royalty on Los Azules and a 27% interest in Paragon Advanced Labs Inc., a publicly listed company deploying PhotonAssay technology worldwide. Chairman and Chief Owner Rob McEwen has personally invested over US$293 million and takes a salary of $1 per year, aligning his interests with shareholders. His goal is to multiply the value of shareholders' investments-and his own-as he did building Goldcorp Inc.
